entities.name: Myojin of Blooming Dawn
entities.description: The Myojin kami of hope on Kamigawa, largely benevolent and never seen up close, leaving blooming flowers in its wake.

entities.name: Myojin of Cleansing Fire
entities.description: Another Myojin representing an aspect of white magic; its relation to the Myojin of Blooming Dawn is unknown.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane where the Myojin of Blooming Dawn wanders.

relations.note: Both represent an aspect of white magic; how they are related is not known.
relations.quote: It is not known how it is related to the Myojin of Cleansing Fire which also represents an aspect of white magic.
